fields.why: A descriptive series of 516 cases: counts, proportions and case fatality with no comparison of groups, periods or exposed vs unexposed; the Saudi-Yemen comparison is explicitly declined and the area 'correlation' is qualitative.

Claims rest on proportions (17% died, 76% animal contact). The mean onset-to-hospitalization and onset-to-death intervals are single descriptive means, neither compared nor interpreted, and province counts are case shares of the 516 total.

brief_issues: Figure 1 (likely an epi curve) is image-only with no description, so case counts by period cannot be checked. Only A's record was in the packet; B is rated from its values.
